s: Unit, integration, E2E, TDD, mocking, test pyramid
d: Untested code is a liability. The testing pyramid: many unit tests (fast), fewer integration tests (realistic), few E2E tests (full flow). Tests give you confidence to refactor and ship. Every professional team expects test coverage.

p: Testing is a critical component of modern backend architecture. It focuses on optimizing performance, ensuring reliability, and scaling the system to handle increasing loads efficiently. Mastering this allows you to build enterprise-grade applications.
1. Understand the core principles and trade-offs.
2. Evaluate open-source tools and industry standards.
3. Implement the pattern within your backend stack.
4. Monitor performance and adjust configurations as scale increases.
